verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway documents load balancing across multiple LLM models/providers and a dedicated 'AI Rate Limiting Advanced' plugin for enforcing rate limits, which together support spreading traffic and throttling. However, there is no explicit documentation of spreading traffic across multiple API keys for the same provider or of request queuing behavior when limits are hit. Missing for 10: explicit key-rotation/multi-key load balancing, request queuing mechanics, and any hands-on/independent verification of these features working together.
